Features

Key Features

Vendor Storefront Management

Each vendor gets their own customizable storefront with product listings, categories, inventory management, and sales analytics.

Custom-Branded Customer App

White-label mobile app that matches your brand. Customers browse, search, add to cart, and checkout seamlessly.

Delivery App & Tracking

Dedicated delivery driver app with route optimization, real-time tracking, and delivery confirmation.

Payment Processing

Secure payment gateway integration supporting multiple payment methods including cards, mobile wallets, and cash on delivery.

Order Management

Complete order lifecycle management from placement to delivery. Real-time status updates for vendors, customers, and drivers.

Analytics Dashboard

Comprehensive analytics for vendors and platform admins. Track sales, popular products, customer behavior, and delivery metrics.

FAQ

What platforms does ChopShop support?
ChopShop includes a web admin panel, iOS and Android customer apps, and a dedicated delivery driver app.
Can I customize the customer-facing app with my branding?
Yes! ChopShop is fully white-label. You can customize colors, logos, fonts, and the overall look to match your brand identity.
How does the delivery system work?
Drivers receive orders through the dedicated delivery app, get optimized routes, and customers can track their delivery in real-time.
What payment methods are supported?
We support credit/debit cards, mobile wallets (Apple Pay, Google Pay), bank transfers, and cash on delivery.
